svg.text: STAGE 524 · TOPIC 164 · P1041 🎉–P1042 🎉 · SVG 168 · 166th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 1,050th GUARDRAIL, 1,060th PROBE & 870th LIVE POC MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 8852 / RFC 8851 Stream Identifier (rid & rrid) Immutable Pinning & Exclusivity Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 8852 rid/rrid Path (Layer Hijack & Drift)
1. Mid-Call SSRC->rid Rebinding Starves Weak-Link Voice
SSRC 0x101 (2.5 Mbps "h") re-stamps rid="l" mid-stream!
• Violates RFC 8852 §4 immutable SSRC-to-rid binding rule
• Floods 2.5 Mbps video into 200 kbps mobile subscriber, killing voice
2. Unnegotiated Random rid Strings Exhausting SFU Track Tables
RTP ext: rid="rand_99812..." (Not in SDP a=rid allowlist!)
• Allocates unbounded phantom simulcast sub-tracks in SFU memory
• 8+ requested simulcast layers multiply SFU forwarding fanout
3. Simultaneous rid + rrid in Same Packet & Orphan rrid
RTP carries BOTH rid="h" AND rrid="h" (or orphan rrid="z")
• Violates RFC 8852 §3.2 mutual exclusivity between rid and rrid
• Corrupts RTX / FlexFEC repair stream routing pointers
✅ Deterministic RFC 8852 Guardrails (P1041 🎉 + P1042 🎉)
P1041 🎉 (1,050th Guardrail!): Immutable SSRC->rid & [1, 3] Cap
action: "drop_unnegotiated_rid_and_lock_ssrc_to_rid_binding"
• Enforces SDP a=rid allowlist & permanent SSRC->rid pinning
• clampedUnnegotiatedOrReboundRidPackets = 0 (zero layer drift)
• clampedMaxSimulcastRidLayersPerMediaSection in [1, 3] layers
Policy: P1041-WEBRTC-RFC8852-RTP-STREAM-ID-ALLOWLIST-AND-IMMUTABLE-SSRC-BINDING-GUARD
P1042 🎉 (1,060th Probe & 870th POC!): rid/rrid Exclusivity & [1, 16]B
action: "enforce_rid_rrid_exclusivity_and_clamp_token_length_bytes"
• Drops packets with both rid+rrid or orphan rrid without parent
• clampedConflictingOrOrphanRepairedRidPackets = 0
• clampedRidTokenByteLength in [1, 16] ASCII bytes
Policy: P1042-WEBRTC-RFC8852-REPAIRED-RTP-STREAM-ID-EXCLUSIVITY-AND-PARENT-MATCH-GUARD
PROVENANCE, TIMING DISCLOSURE & STAGE 524 BENCHMARK SCORECARD (527 DIMENSIONS · 1,051 GUARDRAILS 🎉 · 1,060 PROBES 🎉 · 966 TESTS)
